text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx and RPM spike observed for model-family 'polaris-13b' across us-west-2 pool. Autoscaler triggered additional pods but latency SLOs degrading. Root ts=3123456789
Priya (oncall): seeing the same in Grafana. TPS up ~3x baseline, p50 latency creeping. Any recent deploys?
Dylan (sre): no deploys in last 2h. Error budget warnings for the family. Looking at proxied error logs now.
Sam (runtime): can confirm high KV cache miss rate on polaris variants; long tail tokenization CPU bursts. Might be correlated with a client running long-context workloads.
Priya (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) global per-model RPM cap, 2) per-tenant soft quota, 3) temporarily disable function-calling for polaris (heavy). Want to coordinate.
Leah (product): FYI a handful of large customers (enterprise A + B) are high users of polaris with function calls enabled. Need to flag customer impact before toggling.
Jorge (support): I can pull the active sessions list and ping the customers. Any non-disruptive steps we try first?
Dylan (sre): prefer rate cap first. Sam, can you enact a per-family cap quickly from the runtime control plane?
Sam (runtime): I can push a sculpt policy. Plan: set RPM=1200, TPM=60 for polaris-family, keep other families unchanged. Also set function-calls disabled on polaris to reduce CPU. Will stage in two steps.
Priya (oncall): do it. Post the exact commands. Standby for customer pings.
Sam (runtime): running command now:
```
redwoodctl policies apply --scope model_family:polaris-13b --set rpm=1200,tpm=60 --annotations "mitigation/incident-3123456789"
redwoodctl feature toggle --model-family polaris-13b --feature function_calling --state off --reason "incident-3123456789"
```
Sam (runtime): applied rpm/tpm and toggle. Propagation expected < 30s.
Priya (oncall): observed immediate drop in RPM and 5xx rate falling. p50 latency improving. Metrics: error-rate down ~70% in last 2m.
Jorge (support): pinged Enterprise A and B. They saw degraded throughput but no data loss. Enterprise A requests temporary higher RPM for an internal job.
Leah (product): do not grant special cases during mitigation unless required. Ask them to backoff first; we can consider short manual carveouts.
Dylan (sre): can we do tenant-scoped carveout for Enterprise A if they sign a short commit? Command to carveout: 
```
redwoodctl quotas update --tenant=enterprise-a --model-family=polaris-13b --rpm=3000 --tpm=150 --expires-in=10m
```
Sam (runtime): I can apply a 10-minute emergency carveout if leadership approves.
Avery (eng-lead): Priya loop me in. If it's business-critical customer, ok for a short carveout. Priya, please confirm SLA/impact.
Priya (oncall): Enterprise A confirms it's a short batch job that can be rescheduled. No carveout for now. Keep mitigation in place.
Dylan (sre): monitoring edge cases: function-call disabled might cause client errors. We should add a runtime shim to return a clear 429 + guidance for function-calls disabled to avoid noisy 5xx. Sam, can you route function-call requests to a soft-fail?
Sam (runtime): adding a soft-fail header now. Patch: 
```
# runtime patch snippet
if request.feature == "function_calling" and feature_flag == false:
    return 429, {"retry_after": 900, "detail": "function-calling temporarily disabled for polaris family (incident 3123456789)"}
```
Sam (runtime): patch deployed; responses should be clear.
Priya (oncall): summary so far: per-family rpm/tpm reduced, function-calling disabled, soft 429 in place, customer pings done. Error rate falling, but keep watch.
Jorge (support): customers acked the message. Enterprise B asked for ETA on re-enable.
Leah (product): update them: "we're mitigating a service overload; expect re-evaluation in 30m."
Dylan (sre): let's keep telemetry for next 20m. If stable, we can relax function-calling first then slowly raise rpm/tpm.
Sam (runtime): agreed. Proposed rollback plan: after 25m of stable error rates (<10% of baseline), restore function-calling off->gradual on by canarying 5% of traffic, then increase rpm by +25% increments every 5m. Documented commands to revert: 
```
# revert snippet
redwoodctl feature toggle --model-family polaris-13b --feature function_calling --state on --canary=0.05 --reason "post-incident-3123456789"
redwoodctl policies apply --scope model_family:polaris-13b --set rpm=1500,tpm=80 --annotations "post-incident-step1"
```
Priya (oncall): I'll watch canary. If anything spikes, we'll re-disable.
Avery (eng-lead): good mitigation. Please capture postmortem items: why KV cache miss spike, whether we need tenant-level throttles proactively, and consider per-model graceful degradation settings.
Dylan (sre): capturing logs & traces, will open a pager ticket and link this thread.
Priya (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall @Avery at 3123456895 UTC. If anything else pops, re-alert.
incident-bot: Incident escalated to oncall lead Avery (eng-lead). Priority: P1 -> P2 if stable.
Priya (oncall): tagging this thread for follow-up: postmortem, customer comms, and possible runtime hardening (soft-fail for expensive features).
Sam (runtime): leaving monitoring hooks and dashboards links: https://grafana.redwood/polaris-3123456789 and logs: https://logs.redwood/polaris?tid=3123456789
Leah (product): scheduled customer update in 20m.
Jorge (support): closing customer notifications for now; will reopen if carveouts requested.
Avery (eng-lead): acknowledged handoff. Thanks team.
